# CompoundCalc

> CompoundCalc is a free, privacy-first financial calculation and decision simulator engineered with client-side mathematical precision. Built under GenPopUtils, it provides investors and borrowers with transparent tools to model compound interest, systematic investment plans (SIP), step-up contributions, inflation impact, and debt prepayment strategies with zero tracking or database storage.

## Core Calculators & Decision Simulators

- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/compound-calculator/): Calculate exponential compound growth with custom lump sum, recurring contributions, and flexible compounding frequencies (daily, monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, annually).
- [Step-Up SIP Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/step-up-sip-calculator/): Model wealth accumulation with periodic percentage step-ups to match career income increments.
- [SIP Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/sip-calculator/): Evaluate systematic investment plans with monthly contributions, expected annual returns, and tenure breakdowns.
- [Step-Up Investment Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/step-up-investment-calculator/): Simulate investment portfolios combining lump-sum capital and annual top-up contributions.
- [Investment Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/investment-calculator/): General multi-asset growth calculator with nominal and inflation-adjusted real returns.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/retirement-calculator/): Plan target retirement corpus, post-retirement monthly drawdown, and longevity safety margins.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/inflation-calculator/): Gauge real future purchasing power eroded by price inflation over multi-decade horizons.
- [SWP Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/swp-calculator/): Plan systematic withdrawal plans for regular income while preserving underlying capital.
- [Savings Goal Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/savings-goal-calculator/): Determine required monthly savings to achieve target future financial milestones.

## Debt & Loan Amortization Engines

- [Loan Prepayment Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/loan-prepayment-calculator/): Simulate loan prepayment strategies (one-time lump sum, recurring extra payments, or annual EMI increments) to quantify interest savings and tenure reduction.
- [EMI Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/emi-calculator/): Compute Equated Monthly Installments, total interest payable, and monthly amortization schedules.
- [Home Loan Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/home-loan-calculator/): Model housing mortgages, tax benefits, and multi-year repayment curves.
- [Car Loan Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/car-loan-calculator/): Calculate auto financing payments, total cost of ownership, and early settlement impact.
- [Loan Amortization Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/loan-amortization-calculator/): Generate complete month-by-month and year-by-year principal, interest, and balance schedules with CSV export.
- [General Loan Calculator](https://compoundcalc.genpoputils.com/loan-calculator/): Flexible personal, student, and business loan payoff simulator.

## Technical Architecture & Privacy Guarantees

- **100% Client-Side:** All computations run locally in the browser memory using high-precision financial formulas.
- **Zero Data Collection:** No databases, user tracking, authentication, or external API data transmissions.
- **Multi-Currency:** Native Indian Rupee (INR with Lakhs and Crores formatting) alongside international currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY).
- **Export Capabilities:** Client-side CSV amortization schedule generation and browser-native print optimization.
